title: Riesz representation for non-negative functionals (Simon 4.12, with 4.1–4.5, 4.8)
statement: For every locally compact Hausdorff space X and every additive, positively homogeneous Λ : C_c(X, [0, ∞)) → [0, ∞) (an ℝ≥0-linear map C_c(X, ℝ≥0) → ℝ≥0), there is a Radon outer measure μ on X (Borel regular, finite on compacts, outer regular, inner regular by compacts on open sets) with Λ(f) = ∫_X f dμ for all f.
